kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نقترئ (form VIII)
# نَقْتَرِئُ (naqtariʔu) /naq.ta.ri.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَأَ (iqtaraʔa)
# نَقْتَرِئَ (naqtariʔa) /naq.ta.ri.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَرَأَ (iqtaraʔa)
# نَقْتَرِئْ (naqtariʔ) /naq.ta.riʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِقْتَرَأَ (iqtaraʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
